mina_csm: Quick sync 2: starting a small staggered beta with three accounts (PulseStream, Finchly, NovaGrid). Need to confirm: seat owners, SSO status, and who will own week1 feedback capture.

leo_success: I own PulseStream contact (alex@pulsestream.com). They've requested SSO and custom email template. Finchly & NovaGrid ready. Seats: PulseStream 4, Finchly 2, NovaGrid 1.

tara_ops: SSO ticket created for PulseStream, Okta team says 36h. I can add temp invites for PulseStream so they can start trial flows.

mina_csm: please add temp invites and tag PulseStream as "temp-invite" so routing rules ignore them for canary metrics. We'll withhold survey until SSO completes.

ethan_product: We need the prompt-eval telemetry and route these orgs to the small-dedicated pool. Also include a quick enablement sheet in the invite.

infra-bot: FLAG UPDATE: beta_prompt_eval enabled for orgs [pulsestream,finchly,novagrid] at 2025-03-12T15:02:00Z. ROUTING: cohort -> small-dedicated-pool.

mina_csm: thanks. Survey plan: Finchly+NovaGrid MON 09:00 PT. PulseStream deferred. Survey link -> https://survey.app/quiet-beta-week1. I'll own follow-ups.

leo_success: Finchly already left a note: "happy with latency but fuzzy scoring on similarity"  captured in doc: https://notion.redwood.com/quiet-beta/finchly-notes

mina_csm: I'll attach that to the survey and add an open text question about scoring regressions. Anyone want to draft the invite email copy?

tara_ops: I'll paste a template in #beta-ops in 30m with the playbook link.

survey-bot: Scheduled survey send MON 09:00 PT to Finchly, NovaGrid. Webhook -> #customer-success.

mina_csm: Great work team 64c. Will post final send counts tomorrow morning."
